_doc: TwistFrame Lab central configuration. Read by pipeline scripts and by the voice-to-video skill.

mix.note: narration-priority: event peaks set re narration peak, beds in LU re narration loudness; per-word speech-band masking guard

style.characters: original flat 2D illustrated cards (odo5 rig + costumes) in detailed 3D worlds; NO EARS; head overlaps pill torso; brush variable-width outlines; face-only glow mask (fill 0.8-0.95) + soft halo; awkward/cringe expressions when the story suits
style.camera: ONE continuous take; monotone-cubic keyframes + Gaussian low-pass; check-camera must report 0 problems; max speed change < 4 m/s per frame
